name: CITY COUNCIL MEETING
agenda_text:
CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
September 10, 2019 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

CALL TO ORDER

3.

5.
PUBLIC COMMENT
6.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
6.1
PRESENTATION OF COMMUNITY SPOTLIGHT AWARDS – It is recommended the City Council present Paul Landino, Jose Pineda, and Brian Whitney with a Community Spotlight Award.
6.1 Presentation of Community Spotlight Awards
6.2
PROCLAMATION FOR NATIONAL RECOVERY MONTH - It is recommended the City Council proclaim September 2019 as National Recovery Month in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Desiree Johnson.
6.2 Proclamation for National Recovery Month
6.3
PROCLAMATION FOR NATIONAL PREPAREDNESS MONTH – It is recommended the City Council proclaim September 2019 as National Preparedness Month in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Senior Administrative Analyst Mark Rounds.
6.3 Proclamation for National Preparedness Month
7.
CONSENT CALENDAR
7.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the regular meeting of August 27, 2019.
7.1 Minutes of August 27, 2019
7.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated September 10, 2019 in the total amount of $2,472,424.92.
7.2 Warrant Register - City
7.3
MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING JULY 2019 – It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending July 2019.
7.3 Monthly Treasurer Report - July 2019
7.4
TREE MAINTENANCE SERVICES - REVIEW OF PROPOSALS AND AWARD OF CONTRACT - It is recommended the City Council award the contract for tree maintenance services to West Coast Arborists, Inc. and authorize the City Manager to execute the contract, including any extensions, on behalf of the City.
7.4 Tree Maintenance Services
7.5
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2018-09, SLURRY SEALING AND SIGNING AND STRIPING PLANS FOR BIOLA AVENUE, STAGE ROAD, ESCALONA ROAD, FOSTER ROAD, ADELFA DRIVE AND ALICANTE ROAD – APPROVAL OF JOINT PARTICIPATION AGREEMENT WITH THE CITY OF BUENA PARK - It is recommended the City Council approve the Joint Participation Agreement between the City of La Mirada and the City of Buena Park for the construction of Capital Improvement Project No. 2018-09, Slurry Sealing and Signing and Striping Plans for Biola Avenue, Stage Road, Escalona Road, Foster Road, Adelfa Drive and Alicante Road, for the portion of work within the City of Buena Park and authorize the Mayor to execute the Joint Participation Agreement on behalf of the City.
7.5 CIP No. 2018-09
8.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
8.1
RESOLUTION NO. 19-27 AUTHORIZING THE INSTALLATION OF "STOP" SIGNS WITH ACCOMPANYING STOP BARS AND STOP PAVEMENT MARKINGS ON THE EAST AND WEST APPROACHES OF SABINE DRIVE AT WICKER DRIVE/GAGELY DRIVE - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-27 authorizing the installation of "Stop" signs with accompanying stop bars and STOP pavement markings on the east and west approaches of Sabine Drive at Wicker Drive/Gagely Drive.
8.1 Resolution No. 19-27
8.2
RESOLUTION NO. 19-28 APPOINTING A MEMBER AND ALTERNATE TO THE LOS ANGELES GATEWAY REGION INTEGRATED REGIONAL WATER MANAGEMENT JOINT POWERS AUTHORITY GOVERNING BOARD - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-28 appointing Public Works Director/City Engineer Mark Stowell as the primary board member and Senior Administrative Analyst Marlin Munoz as an alternate board member representing the City of La Mirada on the Los Angeles Gateway Region Integrated Regional Water Management Joint Powers Authority.
8.2 Resolution No. 19-28
8.3
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2018-05, SPLASH! WATERSLIDE INSTALLATION PROJECT - REVIEW OF BIDS, AND AWARD OF CONTRACT, AND RESOLUTION NO. 19-29 AUTHORIZING A BUDGET AMENDMENT - It is recommended the City Council reject Aid Builders, Inc. as non-responsive; award the contract for Capital Improvement Project No. 2018-05, Splash! Waterslide Installation Project, to Western Water Features, Inc. in the amount of $3,783,895; authorize the City Manager to execute the contract on behalf of the City; authorize the City Manager to approve contracts for construction support services in an amount not to exceed ten percent of the construction cost; authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 20 percent of the total project cost; and adopt Resolution No. 19-29 authorizing a budget amendment for the Splash! Waterslide Installation Project.
8.3 CIP No. 2018-05 and Resolution No. 19-29
